question: How does admin add, update and delete shared expenses?

sections.title: Add a shared expense
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when the cost belongs to the group and should later be assigned to one participant for acceptance.
items: Open the Trip Shared section and click Expenses.
Click Add. The Add Trip Shared Expense form opens.
Enter the required name and amount. You can also fill currency, payment method, category, and notes.
Plantour saves the shared expense and returns you to the Trip shared expenses list.

sections.title: Update a shared expense
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when the shared cost already exists and you want to correct its details.
items: Select the shared expense you want to change.
Click Update. The Edit Trip Shared Expense form opens.
Change fields such as name, amount, currency, payment method, category, or notes.
Plantour saves the shared expense and returns you to the list.
sections.afterHtml: Changing who is responsible for a shared expense is handled on the list itself, not inside the add or update form. For that workflow, continue with How does admin assign shared expenses?.

sections.title: Delete a shared expense
sections.beforeHtml: Use this when the trip no longer needs that shared cost entry.
items: Select the shared expense you want to remove.
Plantour removes the shared expense from that trip.
sections.afterHtml: If the expense was already assigned or accepted, review its assignment state first so you do not remove a cost that someone is actively handling.
